tasks.title: Create C LLBL dialect profile module
tasks.detail: Add new module exporting c99/c11/gnu99/gnu11 profile values, freestanding(profile), normalize(opts), and require_feature(ctx, feature, origin). Profiles must expose standard, freestanding, allows_gnu_extensions, allows_typeof, allows_statement_expr, allows_auto_type, allows_asm, allows_vector_attribute, allows_gcc_atomics. Preserve opts.dialect string compatibility for gnu/gnu99/gcc and c11/pure_c11.

tasks.title: Create C LLBL typed AST classes
tasks.detail: Add parent classes CNode/CType/CExpr/CStmt/CDecl/CUnit and concrete leaf class constructors for all existing llbl.c nodes plus new struct/include_local/define_expr/extern_object/extern_fn/proto/object_decl/volatile_decl/block/asm/sizeof/atomic/profile-needed nodes. Preserve __llbl_c role and legacy kind fields where possible for compatibility, but give each node a leaf metatable and class name. Provide role(), is_type(), type_any(), to_expr(), product_items(), cname(), private_name(), raw_escape(), and constructor tables used by the facade.

tasks.title: Implement leaf-owned C renderer
tasks.detail: Add render context and emit_c/type_c/expr_c/declarator helpers that delegate by calling leaf :emit_c(ctx) methods, not kind switches. Reproduce current emit_unit output for existing tests, add rendering for new C nodes: externs, prototypes, struct/union/object declarations, volatile, sizeof, asm, atomics, labels/goto/switch/comments for CBackend projection. Expose emit_unit/emit_decl/type_spelling/expr_spelling/emit_block.

tasks.title: Implement leaf-owned C LLBL formatter
tasks.detail: Move object-DSL formatter out of lua/llbl/c.lua. Add :format_doc(f) methods on concrete classes and formatter table for roles/slots. Preserve spaced-dot formatting assertions for c.unit. demo, c.fn. main, c.decl. acc. Add formatting for new declaration/type/expression/statement leaves.

tasks.title: Implement C syntax validation and raw audit
tasks.detail: Add validate(value, opts) returning a typed-ish report table with issues and raw_escapes, and assert_valid(value, opts) that errors with llbl.c: prefix. Validation must delegate through leaf :validate_c(ctx) methods; check names, parameter/field duplicates, type well-formedness, function/prototype body rules, profile restrictions, statement placement basics, and raw escape reason presence when opts.require_raw_reasons is true.

tasks.title: Rebuild llbl.c facade on typed classes
tasks.detail: Replace current monolithic table/kind implementation with facade requiring llbl.c.ast/profile/render/format/validate. Re-declare C dialect roles including type/expr/unit/types/exprs/inits plus existing decl/stmt/decls/stmts/fields/params. Recreate heads and exports so require('llbl.c'), c.use(), c.fn/static_fn/static_inline_fn, c.typedef_struct, c.typedef, c.include, c.define, c.return_, c.decl, c.auto, c.for_, operators, raw_* remain compatible. Add new public constructors from docs/C_LLBL_REDESIGN.md.

tasks.title: Expand llbl.c direct tests
tasks.detail: Keep the existing exact generated program assertion passing. Add direct assertions for typed leaf classes, role preservation, include_local, define_expr, struct, extern_object, extern_fn, proto, volatile decl, sizeof/sizeof_expr, asm profile rejection, atomic wrappers, validate raw audit, and formatter output for new leaves.

tasks.title: Create NativeStencilCSource object
tasks.detail: Add bind_context(T) module exporting NativeStencilCSource factory/class. It should own holes/continuation ordinals/entry symbol/frame parameter convention/relocation declarations and produce C LLBL declarations/statements. Implement hole_extern, continuation_extern, frame(), hole_address, frame_load, frame_store, tail, relocation_marker_stmt, entry builder, unit(), render_c_text(profile), and template_source(manifest entry/source facts).

tasks.title: Wire native template source render boundary
tasks.detail: Require lalin.native_stencil_c_source and llbl.c near the top. Change append_manifest_source/c_source_from_manifest_entry call sites so C LLBL units or NativeStencilCSource objects are rendered at the final NativeTemplateSource.c_text boundary. Preserve string c_text schema and manifest metadata. Keep temporary string-line compatibility only as an internal migration fallback with audited raw declarations/statements.

tasks.title: Convert native complete micro-op scaffolding
tasks.detail: Convert helper functions around hole_address_expr/frame_load/frame_store/append_hole_externs/continuation_extern and append_complete_code_source/append_complete_next_fragment to build C LLBL values through NativeStencilCSource. First convert frame_entry, scalar_load, scalar_store, scalar_copy, bytes_copy/move, const, unary, binary, compare, cast, select, and address/load/store complete micro-op builders while preserving c_text substrings tested today.

tasks.title: Convert remaining native code source families
tasks.detail: Continue replacing string bodies with C LLBL/native-source-object builders for code term/control, calls, descriptor ABI/copy/result, atomics, branch/jump/switch, trap/unreachable/return, and public ABI adapter families. Use C LLBL atomics, builtins, asm statements, labels/goto/switch nodes instead of raw strings where modeled.

tasks.title: Convert kernel and stencil source families
tasks.detail: Replace string-line construction in kernel/stencil producer/access/point/sink/schedule source builders with NativeStencilCSource/C LLBL values. Preserve current family/source counts and tested substrings such as kernel_trip, elem_size, counter, uint8_t *frame, continuation prototypes, and __builtin_memcpy.

tasks.title: Add native C LLBL source tests
tasks.detail: Extend existing assertions to verify generated native sources still render required C substrings and no marker holes. Add checks that source builders can expose/validate the C LLBL unit before c_text rendering where API exposes it, and that ordinary holes/continuations/frame loads are not emitted through raw escapes.

tasks.title: Create CBackendUnit to C LLBL projection
tasks.detail: Add bind_context(T) module that projects LalinC.CBackendUnit facts to a C LLBL unit/header. Implement scalar/type projection, declaration helpers, atom/place/rvalue projection, statement/terminator/block/function projection, globals/type declarations/layout assertions, includes, signatures, externs, exec prototypes, and section comments. Use C LLBL labels/goto/switch/comments for control flow. Expose emit_type-compatible spelling helpers and project_source_unit/project_header_unit.

tasks.title: Add C LLBL helper generation
tasks.detail: Add emit_helper_c(use, project_type) returning a C LLBL static_inline_fn declaration for helper specs. Keep emit_helper(use, emit_type) as compatibility wrapper by rendering emit_helper_c when possible or using the old string path during transition. Convert atomic/memcpy/memset/trap/intrinsic/int/float helper bodies to C LLBL statements and expressions.

tasks.title: Switch c_emit to C LLBL projection
tasks.detail: Refactor emit_artifact/emit_header/emit_type to use lalin.c_llbl_projection and llbl.c.emit_unit instead of direct string appends. Preserve public API and output section order tested in tests/c_backend/test_c_emit.lua. Use c_helpers.emit_helper_c for helper declarations and render support_source/support_sources only at artifact concatenation boundary.

tasks.title: Update CBackend projection tests
tasks.detail: Keep existing c_emit assertions passing. Add assertions that projection returns/validates C LLBL units (through a new projector API), that generated helpers are C LLBL declarations, and that emitted source/header remain C compiler syntax-checkable.

tasks.title: Run full focused verification
tasks.detail: Run luajit tests/c_backend/test_llbl_c.lua, luajit tests/c_backend/test_c_emit.lua, luajit tests/run.lua c_backend, luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua, and when toolchain is available luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_bank_generator.lua. Record any exact-output deltas intentionally updated in tests.
